question: Why is far-side evolving-minus-fixed floral investment slightly positive at t1000 despite a negative local fixed-resident assurance-to-investment gradient?
scientific_rank: retrospective original-frozen-genome source-level accounting; no new independent histories and no causal mediation
actual_visitor_controls: Restore native matching, investment and assurance diploid alleles at identical original visitor snapshot, use full maternal F, paternal P, selfed S; do not compute future visitor at t1000.

identity.conditions: original zero adult survival, no immigration, no mutation DURING one-generation assay, positive viable resident reproduction and capped exchangeable child recruitment

zero_visitor_analytic.source: Only original records with exactly zero source visitor IDs at each price checkpoint, no imputation of missing pollination.
zero_visitor_analytic.full_not_mediator: This isolates the contemporaneous within-state parental-phenotype alignment effect at zero pollen, not the historical causal effect of enabling A evolution.

readout.descriptive_CI: if computed, paired visitor-history unit; no promotion of previously exposed outcomes
readout.no_survivor_imputation: Trait means undefined for extinct census; all archived initial cohorts were reported occupied at t1000

release_gate: Read four original outer ZIPs in exact 0..3 order; check each original ZIP SHA and NPZ case receipts; verify embedded snapshot source manifests and reproduction source SHA.
No new history, stochastic offspring, mutation or model parameter change.
Exact father/mother pair and full Price covariance identity for every source cell.
Check original t1000 four-arm means against at least each source checkpoint; do not substitute one demographic replicate for 8-repeat main result.
Both null (no visitors) and non-null pollinator source groups included; report all settings without cherry-picking.
Under no visitors, compute and verify the algebraic fixed-genome W and alignment counterfactual.
Condition conclusions on current t200/t400 source; no attribution of full t1000 historical difference to a one-step Price response.
